description: A project's saved board views — the named filter sets above the board's label chips («Countries», «Specs», «No countries»). Each has 'id', 'name', 'only' (labels shown only — ORed), 'hide' (labels hidden — each taken away), 'withWork' (an epic's label reaches its stories and sub-tasks: the clause is epicLabel instead of labels), and 'assignee', 'sprint', 'jql' — the board's own filter values, null where the view leaves that filter as the reader has it. 'query' is the JQL the labels come to, ready for search_issues. 'mayEdit' says whether you may change them with set_board_view / delete_board_view. Any member of the project may read them.
name: list_board_views
title: List board views
